map.PGT 遗传学筛查指征评估器 使用指南: PGT Genetic Screening Indication Evaluator User Guide
map.依据指征逐项评估是否适用 PGT-A、PGT-M 或 PGT-SR，辅助辅助生殖: Evaluates item by item whether PGT-A, PGT-M or PGT-SR applies, supporting assisted reproduction genetic screening decisions.
map.高龄/反复流产/染色体易位。: Advanced maternal age, recurrent miscarriage, or chromosomal translocation.
map.遗传咨询前置评估。: Genetic counseling as a prerequisite assessment.
map.：高龄(≥38)且 RPL≥2 次 → 符合 PGT-A 指征，建议行胚胎非整倍: Age 38 or older with 2 or more recurrent pregnancy losses meets the PGT-A indication, so embryo aneuploidy screening is recommended.
map.：染色体易位 → PGT-SR 指征，筛选正常/平衡胚胎降低流产。: A chromosomal translocation gives a PGT-SR indication; screening normal or balanced embryos reduces miscarriage.
map.PGT-A 非整倍体、PGT-M 单基因病、PGT-SR 结构重排，按指征选择。: PGT-A for aneuploidy, PGT-M for single-gene disease, PGT-SR for structural rearrangements; choose by indication.
map.仅当存在明确指征；需遗传咨询与伦理审批。: Only when a clear indication exists; genetic counseling and ethical approval are required.
